{{Conjecture|legends}}
{{Quote|It is called GSAD-43 and it has upgunned itself considerably. Apparently, it is chasing after the killers who vaped its former master.|[[Devon Fuller]]|<ref name="Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref>}}
An '''individual''' was involved in the last hunt and in the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Janna Relasi]]. Relasi lived long enough to contact her [[Droid/Legends|droid]], [[GSAD-43]], and ordered the droid to "get them for me." GSAD-43 used the onboard computer of [[Janna Relasi's ship]] and through her research, found enough clues to discover the identity of one of the culprits &mdash; although GSAD-43 assumed that there were other involved co-conspirators. GSAD-43 upgraded her weaponry, tracked the murderer, and took that individual to justice.
